first_line_summary: CDC: breastfeeding may continue with first-line anti-TB drugs; concentrations in milk are too low to cause toxicity and do not constitute treatment for the infant.
rifampicin_note: Orange discoloration of breast milk can occur and is harmless.
drug_resistant_note: Do not extrapolate first-line breastfeeding reassurance to BPaLM/BPaL; WHO 2025 excludes breastfeeding from BPaLM/BPaL eligibility due to insufficient safety data.
